temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's suspicion is confirmed and deepened.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death, is grieving, and may be carrying unresolved 'what if' feelings.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley and reassure her that they provided good care.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley admits she feels responsible for the treatment outcome and wonders if pushing for a different approach might have helped; she appreciates reassurance but finds it hard to accept.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's suspicion is confirmed and clarified.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible and burdened by the outcome; she is second-guessing treatment decisions and needs help carrying that burden.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's guilt by reassuring her that they made the best decisions with available information and that she does not have to carry it alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley has been reserved and minimally expressive; she admits she holds back feelings because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak, but agrees to try being more open.

temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her emotions and to reassure her that it is healthy and not a sign of weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley tells Sara the previous confrontation was a bit much, but she knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says they should keep talking.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's worry is partly confirmed but resolved: it was too much for Shirley, yet the friendship and support remain intact.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley understands Sara's good intentions, values the apology, and wants continued talks; Sara should continue supporting her with more sensitivity.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Guilt/remorse shifting to relief and gratitude
temporal_state_chain.intention: To apologize sincerely, mend the friendship, and remain available for Shirley in a gentler way.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley seems better, says the talks and Sara's support have helped, and accepts Sara's suggestion to spend time together outside work this weekend.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara sees concrete improvement and learns Shirley is open to deepening their friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is improving with Sara's support; spending more time together outside work may further help her, and their friendship can grow.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time together on the weekend.
